description: This script determines the source date epoch for a given source directory or file by attempting multiple strategies: reading from a version file, querying version control systems (git or hg), or using file modification time as fallback.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks if a version date file exists and reads its content into SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the latest commit timestamp from git for the specified source.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the latest commit timestamp from hg for the specified source.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Uses Perl to get the modification time of the script itself as a fallback.
